description: This file defines the ToolRepetitionDetector class, which detects consecutive identical tool calls to prevent infinite loops in an AI system. It includes methods for checking tool call similarity, handling special cases like browser scroll actions, and serializing tool call objects.

classes.name: ToolRepetitionDetector
classes.description: A class for detecting repeated tool calls to prevent AI from getting stuck in loops.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the current tool call is identical to the previous one and determines if execution should be allowed.

methods.name: isBrowserScrollAction
methods.description: Determines if a tool use is a browser scroll action (scroll_up or scroll_down).

methods.name: serializeToolUse
methods.description: Serializes a ToolUse object into a canonical JSON string for comparison.
